title: Reports

trigger.title: Generate a findings report
trigger.explainer: A findings run examines a stated scope and produces a signed, printable report: every finding with both verbatim passages and their exact locations, what could not be read, and what was withheld. The PDF is for people; the JSON is the signed record a third party can verify.

countsLine: Sources examined: {{sources}} · facts: {{facts}} · open findings: {{open}} · withheld: {{withheld}} · not fully read: {{notFullyRead}}

delta.firstRun: First report over this scope; changes will show from the next run.
delta.sincePrevious: Since the previous run: {{resolved}} resolved, {{appeared}} new, {{reopened}} reopened.

expiredNote: This report is no longer downloadable: a source it may have quoted was deleted, or its retention window passed. The run record stays for comparison; generate a new report for current findings.

list.title: Past runs
list.emptyHint: Generate a report to get a signed, forwardable record of the contradictions in your documents, with the evidence quoted and located.
